Non – submission of the same will lead to summary rejection of the bid. 2. In case Make in India (MII) Purchase Preference is being applied / requested by the firm while partic ipating in the bid, the details of Make in India Local Content Percentage and Place of Value Additio n as per MII Policy is mandatorily required. In addition to the provisions given in GeM General Terms and Conditions related to exemption of E MD, bidders registered with DRDO, Min of Defence, NSIC, DPSUs, Other Govt.
